item.title: Import packages into Postman | Postman Docs
item.description: You can import packages from your team’s Postman Package Library into scripts in your internal workspaces. You can also import packages from external package registries, such as npm or JSR, into your scripts. Postman supports importing packages into HTTP, gRPC, and GraphQL requests. item.title: How to remove local data – Postman
item.description: Rename the Postman folder so you can differentiate it easily—for example, Postman old. If you're using Windows, go to the Postman download page, install the latest version of Postman and open it. If you're using macOS or Linux, open the Postman Desktop app. This will trigger the creation of a new Postman folder in your local data. Quit the app.

item.title: Newman: run and test your collections from the command line - Postman Blog
item.description: In the Postman app, click on the ellipses (…) next to the collection and select “Export” to download a JSON file of the collection. Similarly, you can download a JSON file of an environment if you’re using one. In the same directory where the JSON file is saved, use Newman to run the collection from the command line.
